verified_facts.text: The lodge sits on the shores of Lake Pehoe in Torres del Paine National Park.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set on the shores of Lake Pehoé in Torres del Paine National Park

verified_facts.text: Guests enjoy complimentary transfers across the lake aboard Explora's own ferry.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests also enjoy complimentary transfers across the lake aboard Explora

verified_facts.text: The lodge was constructed by Chilean architect Jose Cruz Ovalle.
verified_facts.excerpt: Constructed by renowned Chilean architect José Cruz Ovalle

verified_facts.text: Cypress, lenga and almendrillo woods play a fundamental role in the lodge's design.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cypress, lenga, and almendrillo woods play a fundamental role in the design of this unique lodge

verified_facts.text: Near the lodge, the spa has a heated indoor pool, a steam sauna and four open-air hot tubs, all with views to the Paine River.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax in our heated indoor pool, steam sauna, and four open-air hot tubs, all with views to the Paine River.

verified_facts.text: The stay includes more than 40 guided Explorations.
verified_facts.excerpt: discover a singular launching point for adventure and over 40 guided Explorations, all included as part of your stay

verified_facts.text: Explorations are designed for small groups of no more than eight guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: designed for small groups of no more than eight guests

verified_facts.text: Each evening an Explora guide meets with guests to tailor the next day's Explorations to their preferences.
verified_facts.excerpt: when your Explora guide meets with you to help tailor the next day

verified_facts.text: Explorations are led by guides trained at Explora's own School of Guides.
verified_facts.excerpt: led by experts trained exclusively at Explora

verified_facts.text: Guests can ride Explora's own rare breed of Patagonian horses, with access to Explora's own horse stable.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests also enjoy access to Explora’s own horse stable as well as horseback riding and equine Explorations with our own rare breed of Patagonian horses.

verified_facts.text: Between October and April, weather permitting, gauchos hold a Quincho, a traditional Patagonian gathering with roast lamb overlooking the Paine granite towers, at Explora's Estancia 2 de Enero ranch.
verified_facts.excerpt: between October and April and depending on weather conditions – we hold the Quincho: a traditional Patagonian gathering in which the gauchos prepare a roast lamb overlooking the Paine granite towers

verified_facts.text: A catamaran ride over Grey Lake takes guests to Grey Glacier, part of the Southern Ice Fields.
verified_facts.excerpt: A catamaran ride over the Grey Lake will take you to the Grey Glacier, part of the Southern Ice Fields

verified_facts.text: From the Explora dock guests sail across Lake Pehoe to the French Valley.
verified_facts.excerpt: From the Explora dock we sail across Lake Pehoé reaching the French Valley

verified_facts.text: The stay includes all meals and beverages, with an open bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: includes every exquisitely prepared dining experience from breakfast, lunch, and dinner to all beverages and an open bar

verified_facts.text: The dining room has views over Lake Pehoe.
verified_facts.excerpt: our atmospheric dining room, with views over Lake Pehoé

verified_facts.text: The rate includes national park entrance fees and round-trip transfers between Puerto Natales and the lodge.

verified_facts.text: Explora operates the lodge year-round.

verified_facts.text: Wi-Fi access in rooms and common areas may vary in reliability due to the remote location.

verified_facts.text: Explora recommends a minimum stay of five nights.
